verdict.rationale: Cua documents its own controls for limiting what the agent touches. Cua Driver has a "Set permissions" control for what the agent may do. Vault items stay locked until the operator approves unattended access, with Touch ID for sensitive items and a SHA-256 bundle check before an app opens. Apps and accounts can also be confined by moving them into a separate Space. However, the permissions feature appears only as a heading, and nothing shows how app or surface allowlists are defined or that they are technically enforced rather than advisory. Missing for 10: documented per-app/surface/account allowlist semantics, evidence that Driver permissions are enforced at runtime, independent or hands-on corroboration.
